title: dragAndDrop
description: Drag and drop an element from source to target.

target.description: The target location to drop the element.

duration.description: Duration of the drag operation in milliseconds.

surface.description: The browser window/tab the source and target elements live in. Omit to act on the active tab. The targeted tab stays focused afterward.

anyOf.title: Surface (by browser engine)
anyOf.description: Browser engine keyword. Targets that browser. Steps that can only ever act on a browser (not a background process) restrict the bare-string form to this enum, so a process name here is rejected at validation time instead of failing at runtime.

browser.description: Browser engine. Selects the browser surface with that engine (or the one named by `name`). A goTo step opens the browser if it isn't open yet — you can also open one explicitly with `startSurface`; other steps require it to already be open.

name.description: Name of the browser surface. Defaults to the engine name (the context's default browser registers under its engine). Assign distinct names to drive multiple browsers at once, including several of the same engine.

window.description: Which window to act on. Omit to use the active window.
window.title: Window/tab selector

tab.description: Which tab to act on. Omit to use the active tab. Without `window`, the selector searches every tab in creation order — including tabs the page opened itself.
tab.title: Window/tab selector

da8a1b2f8733c.title: Element (simple)
da8a1b2f8733c.description: Display text, selector, or regex pattern (enclosed in forward slashes) of the element.

d381bfe000ddd.description: Display text or regex pattern (enclosed in forward slashes) of the element. If combined with `selector`, the element must match both the text and the selector.

d94a8bcb1ecfb.description: Selector of the element. If combined with `elementText`, the element must match both the text and the selector.

d51f552441335.description: ID attribute of the element to find. Supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax.

de98afd642d66.description: data-testid attribute of the element to find. Supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax.

d36879a346bf0.description: Class or array of classes that the element must have. Each class supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax. Element must have all specified classes.

df5fb044d9398.description: Object of attribute key-value pairs that the element must have. Values can be strings (supporting /pattern/ regex), numbers, or booleans. Boolean true matches attribute presence, false matches absence.

da993bab30b8c.description: Computed accessible name of the element per ARIA specification. Supports exact match or regex pattern using /pattern/ syntax.

timeout.description: Max duration in milliseconds to wait for the element to exist.

d34d60ebb0a88.title: By index
d34d60ebb0a88.description: Index in creation order. Negative counts from the end; `-1` is the newest.

dcef07241c15a.title: By name
dcef07241c15a.description: Name assigned when the window/tab was opened (goTo `newTab`/`newWindow`). The integer branch is listed first because Ajv validates with coerceTypes — string-first would coerce integer indexes into name strings.

db83479a87432.description: Name assigned when the window/tab was opened.

index.description: Index in creation order. Negative counts from the end.

title.description: Page title to match. Substring, or /regex/.

url.description: Page URL to match. Substring, or /regex/.
